method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the person with a claim in a representative proceeding (a group member, or the representative party for the questions that say so), with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; dates in one module, the rules and the exported questions in another, worked cases in a third; four regulative rules (opting out, claiming from the fund, a group member's appeal, suing once the limitation period runs again) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Civil Proceedings Act 2011 (Qld), act-2011-045, the version in force from 2026-10-29 (current on 2026-11-06), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2011-045.txt (text sha256 34fbd8d61aa4d587bb1e9250b7ce8a087137fcd057a29443cc4bc6cba169d1a8), converted from the Queensland Legislation HTML view

seat: the person with a claim in a representative proceeding (class action) in the Queensland Supreme Court: a group member, and, for the questions that say so, the representative party who starts and runs it (cpq13a-member.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run cpq13a-dates.l4 ; l4 run cpq13a-member.l4 ; l4 run cpq13a-cases-member.l4
checks.result: 166 assertions written, 166 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Part 13A (representative proceedings in the Supreme Court, ss 103A-103ZC), with s 111 (which proceedings it reaches). In: ss 103A-103H, 103I-103L, 103P-103T, 103U(8), 103V(1)(f) and (3), 103W(3)(b)-(c) and (4), 103X, 103Y(3), 103Z, 103ZB with 103M(3) and 103N(2), 103ZC, 111. Out: the court's management and orders (ss 103M(1)-(2), 103N(1), 103O, 103U(1)-(7), the rest of 103V and 103W, 103Y(1)-(2), (4)-(6)), s 103ZA (general power), and the rest of the Act (outside this focus). Reasons in NOTES.md.
